upfront_predictions_and_limitations: For the A pump with both q even, odd-mode amplitudes vanish by exact translation parity symmetry.
With q=6 only or q=28 only, mode 36 is unreachable from source 2 by exact congruence symmetry.
The reversed pump can excite mode 36 through 2->30->36; the first edge is not a legal UNNS T_N edge.
Under the same A pump, source 4 can excite target 38 although no positive-length UNNS history connects 4 to 38.
The grating harmonics are engineered from the targeted mode differences, not chosen blindly from physical measurements; predictive advantage beyond standard Maxwell/Fourier theory is NOT claimed.
